entries.en: to fit; to have room or capacity for
to win people's hearts; to be held in favor by the people

entries.zh: 旁边；边上（cabo，边沿）〔原稿音写存疑：groūg 或 prōng〕
entries.notes: source_M 栏标 [疑]，音写两读不定，据 R 栏 pāng 旁 定语义。

entries.en: end of a thread; beginning of a silk strand
squad; troop, company of men (cabo de esquadra)
squad leader; corporal, head of a squad

entries.zh: 对年；周年祭（人去世满一周年之忌日）
entries.en: first death anniversary; the yearly memorial of a death (cabo de año)
spine/back of a knife blade (cabo de cuchillo)

entries.zh: 带仔尾；针尾带线端（agujeta 小针/别针之线尾）
entries.en: end of the thread on a small needle/lace-tag (cabo de agujeta)
entries.notes: agujeta 在 17 世纪可指小针或饰带扣针，具体所指依赖推断。

entries.zh: 阉羊；去势的公羊〔汉字栏标疑：閹/鏈，据西语 capado 定为 閹〕
entries.notes: source_H 栏标 [疑:閹/鏈]，依西语 cabron capado 与音写 iám 判为 閹。

entries.zh: 呼鸡；母鸡咯咯叫（cacarear）〔M 栏残缺，叠写一行大半为墨渍覆盖〕
entries.en: the hen to cluck/cackle (cacarear la gallina); to call the hens
entries.notes: source_M 栏标 [残]，仅据 L/H/R 三栏定语义；H 栏另标 [疑:雞/隻]。
